experienceInnAlternative.scope: Matched Traveler heal5 C0 Lv60 craft+6 talent6. Three paired six-run campaigns; no food; native inn if HP<50% or KO. These are independent policy replays, not the identical food-campaign RNG path. All main XP receipts preserved. No claim of globally fastest route.

minigameClockSensitivity.status: Arithmetic full-scene-duration sensitivity only; not an actual new native ledger replay. Identical successful all-node tap input cannot wait for the full limit in the product UI, which auto-finishes when all nodes are collected. Actual elapsed finishes after last tap+400ms; generic start/finish6s allowance is separate. Slow input/misses/network are not guaranteed by this perfect-tap model.

growth50to60.method: 50→55 holds actual Lv50 post-public-ascension phase5 six-run stage55 cost.55→60 linearly averages actual public-ascended Lv55 and Lv60 six-run stage60 cost. All boundaries end same native Liyue inn with full HP, acquire exact menus from zero ingredient/food inventory, and repay cash at actual native wealth rate. Diagnostic acquisition party is separate Lv60 four-star C0. This is a boundary budget, not continuous natural-account play.

leyline4c0.rateLimitation: secondsPerNetMora is a conditional marginal cash-work conversion for this sample from blossom to actual full inn. It is not steady hourly income, excludes wait/acquisition/initial trip and is not interchangeable with longer material-site-to-blossom-to-material-site trip conversion. Failures stay recorded and cost10% of the diagnostic1000000 wallet, not a universal100000 defeat tariff.

assumptions: Four declared owned C0 actors, ordinary owned crafted+6 and legal base talents6; no artifacts/exclusive/boss equipment. Recipe flags, initial ingredient grants for diagnostic cooking and funded wallet are explicit preparation. Exact consumed menu is separately acquired through native actions from zero stock.

Displayed2x native frames plus3s combat input/6s receipt/4s move/10s inn helper; gathering uses actual timed inputs and early completion, upper-duration sensitivity retained. Human/network delay and global real-hour waiting excluded from the active-work conversion.

Initial domain approach, obtaining ownership/gear/talents/ascension material, outside quest/reward income and market liquidity excluded. Each six-run budget starts procurement from zero, including repeated recipe unlocking, so stock reuse can lower repeated cost.
All receipts and failures retained. Direct-gather6-menu check and NPC mix are paired selected diets, not every possible element/weapon/party or globally optimal supply route.
Fair main-combat endpoint is same inn/fullHP. Every nonempty acquisition route also returns with fullHP; empty menus make no trip and incur no acquisition HP debt.
